title: Selected free assignments for a junta
statement: Let $n,M$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates in $P$. For a natural number $R$, suppose $M$ is at most the number of indices $r	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(R)$ whose fixed assignment equals $z$, and let each such index have a free assignment on the coordinates outside $P$. The selected batch is the $M$-indexed list of free assignments at the matching indices chosen by the fixed-matching-index embedding.
